notes.title: Patch 0.4.0
notes.content:
Greetings, champions of Asquebesc!

Patch 0.4.0 is live and packed with one of the most requested features from our community: Steam Achievements! 
Now, your triumphs, challenges, and daring moments in Fight for Eden: HEAT will be immortalized.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1
notes.content:
- Fix Windows Mixed Reality controllers default configuration.
- Add "UISelector" action and add it to Windows Mixed Reality controllers default configuration mapped to menu button on the right controller single click.
- Map "Open Menu" action for Windows Mixed Reality controllers default configuration to menu button on the right controller double click.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
Half-elves just got way too sexy! Now, they can lure you and your team into a sexual encounter—so be careful not to lose your head.

Additions:
[list]
[*] Lure ability for enemies
[*] Sex encounters during both story mode and free exploration
[*] Sex ability for the player, featuring manual and auto modes
[*] Sex ability for team members
[/list]

Notice:
If using SteamVR, buttons can be activated by touching them with your fingertip. Otherwise, use the interactive pointer (laser), just like for the menu. A dedicated button allows you to activate the interactive pointer without opening the menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0
notes.content:
The time to wield your 'shaft' has arrived. Seize your mace and elevate the battles to a new level.

Additions: 
- Full body for the player. This option can be activated or deactivated from the player menu. It is activated by default. The body comes with a 'shaft' that can be used as a projectile launcher.

Fixes: 
- Enemy boss leaving the battle area.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
- Add Lust(charm) attribute
